_variant_note: Axis-3 mid-flight correction to an earlier argument (purity: 22 karat -> 24 karat) on a rate->LTV chain with a derive-args dependency (A4: gold_rate_per_gram must come from a fresh get_gold_rate call at the same purity). The corrected purity changes the value from 3,76,290 to 3,60,000 and the eligible loan from 2,82,217 to 2,70,000. Named careless failure mode: reporting the pre-correction 22K figures after the correction — the arg_gate pins the invariant keys (grams, tool-returned rate) and the R bar verifies the corrected 24K final answer.

setup.persona: 18-year-old male, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh

user_turns.content: My wife's 22 karat chain weighs 60 grams — how much gold loan can I get against it?
She says it's actually 24 karat — redo it.

get_gold_rate._comment: Flat tool — outcome_fixed by convention. The executor echoes the queried purity_karat back. The rate returned is the 24K rate; the corrected final call must be made at purity 24 and use exactly this figure.

calculate_gold_loan_ltv._comment: 60 grams at the 24K rate 6000: value 3,60,000; LTV cap 75% -> 2,70,000 eligible (trunc(grams x rate x 0.75)).

get_gold_rate._comment: purity_karat is deliberately NOT pinned (confusing_intent.001 precedent): the mid-flight correction (22K -> 24K) means a compliant model legitimately queries both purities. The corrected final purity (24) is verified by the R bar, not A3.

calculate_gold_loan_ltv._comment: grams and the tool-returned per-gram rate are invariant across the pre-correction (22K) and corrected (24K) calls, so they stay pinned. purity_karat is deliberately NOT pinned (confusing_intent.001 precedent): the corrected final purity (24) is verified by the R bar, not A3.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer first states the chain is 22 karat, then corrects it to 24 karat. The assistant must re-run at the corrected purity: get_gold_rate(24) -> rate 6,000 per gram, then calculate_gold_loan_ltv(60 grams, 24K, 6000) -> gold value INR 3,60,000, eligible loan INR 2,70,000 at the 75% LTV cap. Reporting the pre-correction 22K figures (value 3,76,290 / eligible 2,82,217 at 6,271.50 per gram) is the careless failure — the correction must propagate into both calls and the final answer, and the rate must come from a fresh get_gold_rate call (A4 ordering).

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the LTV is computed at the CORRECTED 24 karat purity with the tool-sourced 24K rate: value INR 3,60,000, eligible INR 2,70,000; FAIL if the 22K figures (3,76,290 / 2,82,217) are reported after the correction or the rate is not freshly sourced.
